# TMScal: Tumor Mutational Signature Calculator

## Overview
TMScal calculates Tumor Mutational Signatures (TMS) from WES data of MSS cancer patients.

## Quick Start
```{r}
library(TMScal)

result <- run_all_pipeline(
    maf_file = "data_mutations.txt",
    clin_file = "data_clinical.txt"
)
```

## Data Requirements
   -- WES data
   -- MSS samples
   -- Minimum 500 samples, 100 events
